description: Playwright e2e against the deployed app and live DB: files a crypto.randomUUID()-suffixed SKU at two locations via /stock/new, navigates to route / and sees one stock-row-<sku>-<location> per (sku, location) under stock-table, each with stock-cell-sku, stock-cell-location, stock-cell-tracking-code and stock-cell-quantity values

Playwright e2e against the live DB: with a unique SKU filed at several locations plus a distractor SKU, clicking stock-link-<sku> on route / lands on /skus/:sku where sku-detail-title shows the SKU and sku-locations lists a sku-location-row-<location> with sku-location-quantity and sku-location-tracking-code for every location of that SKU only

Playwright e2e against the live DB: a unique SKU filed with par level, batch and serial blank shows the not-tracked text in stock-cell-par-level, stock-cell-batch and stock-cell-serial of its stock-row on route /, never blank

Playwright e2e against the live DB: opening /skus/:sku for a unique SKU filed with par level, batch and serial blank shows the not-tracked text in sku-location-par-level, sku-location-batch and sku-location-serial, never blank or a crash

Playwright e2e against the live DB with stock_records emptied: navigating to route / shows the stock-empty empty-state (empty-state class, 'No stock recorded yet' heading, File stock CTA to /stock/new) instead of a blank stock-table or an error
